settings.title: Where to find us
settings.lead: Walterin is drawn and published by Walter Ihring. We are based in Bratislava, and we send books and cards from here across the European Union.
settings.globe_alt: A drawn globe with a mark on Bratislava. Drag it to turn it.

settings.heading: Online
settings.text: We are here. Our shop is where you buy Walterin — and we send it anywhere in the European Union.

settings.heading: Bookshops and stores
settings.text: Do you run a bookshop or a store? Write to us. We would like to talk about how Walterin would look on your counter.
